secretaryHint: Runs Secretary Code’s own engine in this project. Sessions are saved in your workspace. External coding CLIs are optional.
rustHint: Preview: runs the bundled OpenCode Rust engine with an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic provider. It has no MCP, plugins or the full v2 route set yet.
engineUnavailable: Secretary Code’s bundled engine is unavailable. Rebuild the app or set SECRETARY_ENGINE_PATH to its executable.
invalidModel: Use a model in provider/model format.
